issue_request: FHIR-16606 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction from the PA work group for STU3. It requested changing the Patient Detailed Descriptions comment for Patient.multipleBirth[x] from 'bool' and 'valueBool=true' to 'boolean' and 'valueBoolean=true'.
initial_application: Historical commit c3db39b3a857cf5a34988fbc05a935d8ed67a278, 'fixed typos GF#16603,16605,16606', changed source/patient/patient-spreadsheet.xml from the Jira's existing wording to the requested corrected wording. The Jira also has an October 2018 comment saying the issue was already fixed.
additional_context: Patient is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative Patient definition is now source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml, where Patient.multipleBirth[x] already says 'If a boolean value was provided ... valueBoolean=true'. Later multipleBirth work expanded surrounding fetus/pre-birth guidance without reintroducing the typo. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence. FHIR-16605 was touched by the same historical typo commit and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-16603 was only a separate typo mentioned by that commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already satisfies FHIR-16606 and no source edit is needed.
